# Vendored D toolchain

Upstream code, vendored **unmodified**. Do not edit these files in place —
changes are lost on update, and `glue.js` encodes several non-obvious invariants
(see "Load-bearing details" in the [project README](../README.md)).

## Provenance

Source: the `wasm-web-app` branch of [`dkorpel/dmd`](https://github.com/dkorpel/dmd/tree/wasm-web-app/compiler/wasm/web)
(`compiler/wasm/web`), as deployed to <https://dkorpel.github.io/dmd-explorer/>.

That branch is upstream `dlang/dmd` `master` plus a WebAssembly backend and
`-mwasm-selflink` support. It is **not** in upstream `master`, so the compiler is
pinned to the deployed build rather than to a DMD release.

Downloaded 2026-09-17 (`Last-Modified: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 18:57:49 GMT`).

| File | Size | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dmd.wasm` | 26,209,599 | `65039FCC95A116E2007A0F74279B29868A882676B105B26005840A74965EBC45` |
| `glue.js` | 15,981 | `55900DA4E476730FE40CDAF91E29C29C87B8D68940F256BE0215130208891B49` |
| `worker.js` | 2,732 | `3E918E00CE273DE3F1543AC23FA2EBB67BB034B58D389696AD2559E351606CE4` |

## Update

```sh
base=https://dkorpel.github.io/dmd-explorer
curl -fO $base/dmd.wasm
curl -fO $base/glue.js
curl -fO $base/worker.js
```

Then re-check the worker protocol and the exported `dmdwasm_*` symbols against
`index.html`, and re-run the checks in the project README.
